verdict.rationale: Vue's core value proposition is exactly this: components with local reactive state (docs-1,2,3,4) and official ecosystem pieces (router, Vuex/store) for composing them into larger apps, corroborated by hands-on developer accounts praising SFC encapsulation and reactivity ergonomics (vue-comm-9, vue-comm-10, vue-comm-3, vue-comm-12). Some community caveats exist about state clarity in complex apps (vue-comm-8, vue-comm-11) but these don't concretely contradict the capability, only note limits at scale. Missing for 10: independent technical benchmarks/case studies of large-scale composed component architectures beyond anecdotal HN comments.
